exposure: Cesarean delivery due to NRFHR vs. labor dystocia
cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate
Cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR)
cohort: Singletons born between 1999-2014 at a single tertiary regional medical center
finding: Offspring born by cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate patterns had a higher risk of infectious morbidity-related hospitalizations compared to those born by cesarean delivery following labor dystocia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery due to NRFHR is associated with an increased risk of pediatric infectious morbidity-related hospitalizations.
